feat(updates): Add multiple new updates for Azure services and GitHub Apps

- Added public preview for Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager namespace-scoped resource placement.
- Launched general availability for Azure Container Storage v2.1.0 with Elastic SAN integration.
- Introduced an AI Skills Executor in .NET leveraging Anthropic’s agent pattern.
- Enabled GitHub Apps to utilize public preview Enterprise Teams APIs with fine-grained permissions.
- Released general availability for instant access support for incremental snapshots of Azure Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disk.
- Added support for Azure Front Door Premium with Azure Private Link origins in UAE North.
- Launched general availability for encryption at host and disk encryption sets in AKS node auto-provisioning.
- Enabled LocalDNS support for AKS node auto-provisioning enabled clusters.
- Added general availability for quota and deployment troubleshooting tools in Azure Functions Flex Consumption.
- Expanded Azure Premium SSD v2 disk availability to Brazil Southeast and additional Availability Zones in Malaysia West and Indonesia Central.
- Implemented a script to shorten filenames for updates2 items to prevent filename collisions.
